target.title: fix: reject Telegram topic sessions_send targets
target.body:
Closes #99835

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users calling `sessions_send` with a Telegram topic session key could dispatch an inter-agent run against the topic child session instead of getting the existing thread-session rejection.

## Why This Change Was Made

The direct-target guard now uses the full session thread parser, so loaded/plugin-owned session conversation metadata is considered before dispatch. This keeps Telegram topic handling at the channel/plugin session-key boundary rather than adding Telegram-specific `:topic:` parsing to the generic core suffix parser.

Related PR #99844 covers the same issue by teaching the generic suffix parser about `:topic:`. This PR instead follows the issue review's requested fix shape: reuse the plugin-owned lightweight session-key resolver path for `sessions_send`.

## User Impact

Telegram topic session targets now receive the same parent-session guidance as other thread child sessions. The tool rejects before queueing or dispatching an agent run, so users avoid accidental nested work in the topic child context.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: `sessions_send` rejects a Telegram topic session target before gateway dispatch when the loaded channel session resolver classifies the key as threaded.
- Focused regression: `node_modules\\.bin\\vitest.cmd run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-tools.config.ts src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts --reporter=verbose -t "rejects Telegram topic session targets"` -> 1 passed.
- Neighbor coverage: `node_modules\\.bin\\vitest.cmd run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-tools.config.ts src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts --reporter=verbose -t "rejects direct thread session targets|rejects Telegram topic session targets|rejects label targets that resolve to canonical thread sessions|does not disclose a resolved thread session key"` -> 4 passed.
- File-level proof: `node_modules\\.bin\\vitest.cmd run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-tools.config.ts src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts --reporter=verbose` -> 44 passed.
- Hygiene: `git diff --check` -> passed.
- Review: `python .agents\\skills\\autoreview\\scripts\\autoreview --mode local` -> `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
- Not tested: live Telegram bot/device behavior. Crabbox/Testbox was unavailable locally earlier because the `crabbox`/`blacksmith` binaries were not found, so this PR keeps the claim to the tested sessions_send runtime boundary and plugin-owned session-key parser behavior.
